verdict.rationale: Sentry says it is SDK-based with "No agents to install," so it offers no vendor-maintained host, container, or Kubernetes agents. Infrastructure telemetry can only arrive indirectly: OTLP ingest of traces and logs via the third-party OpenTelemetry Collector. Cloud-service coverage is thin, limited to integrations like Cloudflare Workers and Convex. Missing for 10: vendor-maintained host/container agents, Kubernetes instrumentation, broad cloud-provider integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure metrics collection.
